p: bring up the ark of the: For David brought it from Obed-edom, and placed it in the tabernacle which he made for it in 2Sa 6:17.
Ethanim: Containing part of September and part of October, in which they held three solemn feasts, Nu 29:1.
priests brought in the ark of: That is, the Kohathites, Nu 4:5.
drew out the staves: They drew them out only far enough to be seen, for they could not pull them out completely, Ex 25:15.
save the two tables of stone: For it is likely that the enemy when they had the ark in their hands took away the rod of Aaron and the pot of manna.
ever: He spoke according to the tenor of God's promise which was on the condition that they served him correctly.
covenant of the LORD: The two tables in which the articles of the covenant were written.
all their heart: Truthfully and without hypocrisy.
But will God indeed dwell on: He is ravished with the admiration of God's mercies, who being incomprehensible and Lord over all will become familiar with men.
and an oath be laid upon: That is, the judge or neighbours.
do: That is, make it known.
confess thy name: Acknowledge your just judgment and praise you.
shut up: So that there is a drought to destroy the fruit of the land.
heart: For such are most suitable to receive God's mercies.
stranger: He means such as should be turned from their idolatry to serve the true God.
name: That this is the true religion with which you will be worshipped.
in the land of them that: Though the temple was the chief place of prayer, yet he does not exclude them who being forced by necessity to call upon him in other places.
their land: As Daniel did in Da 6:10.
have compassion on them: He understood by faith, that God of enemies would make friends with them who converted to him.
end of praying all this prayer: Solomon is a figure of Christ, who continually is the mediator between God and his Church.
incline our hearts unto him: He concludes that man of himself is enemy to God, and that all obedience to his law proceeds from his mercy.
house of the LORD: Before the oracle where the ark was.
Hamath unto the river of Egypt: That is, from North to South: meaning all the country.
seven days and seven days: Seven days for the dedication, and seven for the feast.
